description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'BasicGestureDetectFragment' which implements gesture detection within a view. It sets up a GestureDetector with a custom gesture listener, and ties it to a view's touch events to detect user gestures.

classes.name: BasicGestureDetectFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that detects gestures on a view and manages logging of gesture events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates it has an options menu.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the gesture detection by creating a GestureDetector and attaching a touch listener to the view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu item, specifically to clear the log when a certain item is selected.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the log displayed in the associated LogFragment.
